home.eyebrow: Dandali daya, wanda ya dace da halin da kake ciki
home.headline: Gaskiyar kudi da za a iya tabbatarwa, a kowace nahiya
home.subheadline: Bincike na shari'a tare da sarkar kriftography, lissafin kudi wanda ya dace da dokoki da tattalin arzikin yankinka, da nazarin farashin naÃƒÂºra don gasa na gwamnati. Duk a cikin dandali daya wanda ke girma tare da kai.
home.statLabel: An gina shi don ainihin sauyi
home.statDescription: A cikin tattalin arzikin da hauhawar farashi ta shekara ta wuce kashi 1,000, bayanan kudi suna rasa maana cikin makonni. Injin lissafin kudinmu yana sake bayyana kowace lamba ta atomatik kowane wata, ko da yaushe halin tattalin arzikinka yana da sifili nawa. Wannan dabara ce ta bakiliki da muke amfani da ita akan kowane yanki mai sauyi mai yawa, ba lamari daya kadai ba.
home.pillarsTitle: Ra'ayoyi guda uku akan gaskiya daya
home.pillar1Desc: Bincike na shaidar dijital tare da sarkar kiyayewa da za a iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar hash na kriftography. Kowace rikodi tana da alaka kuma ba za a iya canza ta ba tare da barin alama.
home.pillar2Desc: Jadawalin asusun da aka daidaita bisa ga sashe da yanki, rufe lokaci bisa ga IFRS, da injin kadai a kasuwa tare da daidaitawar hauhawar farashi na asali (IAS 29) don tattalin arzikin da ke da sauyi mai yawa.
home.pillar3Desc: Nazarin farashin naÃƒÂºra don matakan sayayya na gwamnati, tare da jerin rarrabuwa na hukuma da injin kudin aiki.

servicios.headline: Ayyuka na Dabaru
servicios.subheadline: Mafita na musamman a cikin bincike na dijital, lissafin kudi na yankuna da yawa, da hankalin hadarin kudi.
servicios.service1Desc: Kimanta fasaha na shaidar dijital, bin diddigin takardu da za a iya tabbatarwa ta hash, da nazarin hadari da aka tsara.
servicios.service2Desc: Cikakken lissafin kudi na IFRS, wanda aka daidaita don dokokin haraji na yankinka, tare da daidaitawar hauhawar farashi ta atomatik inda tattalin arzikinka ke bukata.
servicios.service3Desc: Bincike na jakunkuna da mu'amaloli, da rarraba hadarin kudi tare da shaida da za a iya tabbatarwa ta hanyar kriftography.
servicios.service4Desc: Nazarin farashin naÃƒÂºra da tsara tayin don matakan sayayya na gwamnati.
servicios.service5Desc: Atomatik na tabbatarwar doka da lura da bin doka akai-akai.
servicios.service6Desc: Yayin da muke karban masu amfani daga sabbin yankuna, muna gina kayan aikin haraji da doka wanda wannan yanayin musamman ke bukata.

tecnologia.headline: Fasaha
tecnologia.subheadline: Kayan aiki da aka gina akan ka'idojin tabbatarwa: kowace rikodin lissafin kudi tana da alaka ta hanyar kriftography, ana tabbatar da kowace sanarwa kafin a mika ta, kuma kowane yanki yana da dokokinsa masu aiki ba tare da tasiri ga wasu ba.
tecnologia.feature1Desc: Kowace rikodin jarida tana da alaka da wacce ta gabata ta hanyar hash na SHA-256. Canza rikodin tarihi yana karya sarkar ta hanyar da za a iya ganowa ta lissafi.
tecnologia.feature2Title: Injin Sake Bayyanawa don Hauhawar Farashi
tecnologia.feature2Desc: Daidaitawa ta atomatik na dukkanin bayanan kudi 4 (Ma'auni, Bayanin Ribar-Asara, Jarin Kamfani, Kudaden Shiga) bisa ga IAS 29, kowane wata, ta amfani da alamar farashin hukuma na kowace kasa.
tecnologia.feature3Desc: Samfuran nazari don gano tsari mai shakku da kimanta hasashe na hadarin kudi.
tecnologia.feature4Desc: Rabuwar bayanai a matakin kamfani a cikin database, tabbatarwa ta hanyoyi biyu na zabi, da matsayin shiga daki-daki ga kowane mai amfani.
